Chapter 655: Chapter 4: Does the Tower Master Want Me to Refine the Galaxy Master? (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

“`

“Is someone up ahead attempting another challenge?” the brawny man felt a tinge of disappointment. Was he not the first one to enter the Demon Jade Space?

“Are they challenging the first layer or the second layer?” the brawny man received information from Statue Shen Ji and was aware of the difficulties of each layer.

“Hm?”

“The fifth layer?”

The brawny man looked up towards the upper levels and saw the fifth floor of Black Tower illuminated by a hazy light, immediately realizing that the person ahead of him was challenging this very layer.

...

“The fifth layer?” The brawny man’s eyes widened with surprise. From the information passed on by Stone Statue Shen Ji, he knew that to conquer the fifth layer, one must have a thorough understanding of the Rule of Time.

Understanding the Rule of Time? In the eyes of the brawny man, that domain was only achievable by ancient Eleventh Rank powerhouses.

“Just which Eleventh Rank powerhouse is attempting it…” the brawny man was stunned. If not for the presence of a mere Spirit Will in this place, he would have fled without any hesitation.

Eleventh Rank powerhouses… In reality, it probably would take but a single thought to obliterate him countless times over, and to be in proximity to such beings would make anyone’s scalp tingle.

…

The fifth floor of Black Tower.

Lin Yuan stood near the center, feeling the boundless power of time surge around him.

[Your perception is defying the heavens; you’ve sensed many Time Fluctuations and discerned the two-thousand one-hundred and seventy-third Rule Model of Time…]

…

In a moment of lucidity, an illusory model of the Rule of Time coalesced before Lin Yuan.

This Rule Model of Time had a sense of perfection, seemingly encompassing the vast variations of time’s rules.

“Is this the final Rule Model of Time?”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes. Having grasped the crucial point, his understanding of the Rule of Time had reached a certain height. To move forward, he needed to carve out his own path.

Every master who has fully understood the Rule of Time perceives it differently.

The Space Rules are vast and endless, with many ‘aspects’. To say one has thoroughly grasped the Space Rules is merely to have understood one aspect of the vast Space Rules.

The Rule of Time is the same.

“It’s time to leave.”

Lin Yuan looked at the remaining road ahead, knowing he had not yet fully grasped the Rule of Time and there was no hope of passing through.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared outside Black Tower.

“Hmm?”

“Is there someone else here?”

Lin Yuan immediately noticed the brawny man’s presence.

The Spirit Will he had sent to the Demon Jade Space had its appearance and body set at random, partly intending to conceal his identity.

“Having met… having met senior.” The brawny man’s scalp tingled as he hastened to offer his respects to Lin Yuan.

In his heart, the young man before him was an ancient Eleventh Rank powerhouse, and he himself did not even have the qualification to look him in the eye.

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

He could tell that the brawny man was human.

That was enough. If the brawny man belonged to a different species, or even a species hostile to humanity, Lin Yuan would probably use his authority as a core member to temporarily expel him.

But a human? As a fellow human, Lin Yuan didn’t mind the other trying to challenge the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

The rewards from inside Nine Floors Dark Tower completely depended on the shown talent, and most of the rewards obtained by the practitioners were not too precious.

“Senior…”

The brawny man bowed his head, not daring to let out even a sliver of perception, for fear of unsettling the Eleventh Rank powerhouse who had just finished the fifth layer.

After a long while, the brawny man mustered the courage to look up, only to find that there was no one in front of him anymore, save for the Stone Statue Shen Ji looking at him.

“`

“Has the senior left?” The burly man let out a heavy sigh of relief internally, “Is the senior also a human?”

Through the brief glimpse just now, the burly man had also realized that Lin Yuan was human.

“I wonder which Eleventh-Rank Evolver from our Human Alliance it is?” The shock in the burly man’s heart still hadn’t dissipated.

Had he actually had the fortune to meet an Eleventh-Rank Evolver today?

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan, after comprehending all the Rule of Time models, was in good spirits.

“Right.”

“Xia Qin Supreme Being told me to find him once I had understood all the Rule of Time models,” Lin Yuan recalled the instruction from Xia Qin Supreme Being.

He immediately connected his consciousness to the Virtual World.

…

Lofty Evolution Tower World.

Xia Qin Supreme Being sat upon his throne, his expression subtly changing.

“That kid wants to see me, could it be…” Xia Qin Supreme Being’s thoughts were complex. How had Lin Yuan comprehended all the Rule of Time models in such a short time?

A moment later.

The figure of Lin Yuan appeared.

“Supreme Being.” Lin Yuan bowed slightly.

“You’ve comprehended all the Time models?” Even though he had expected it, Xia Qin Supreme Being still asked once more.

“Yes.” Lin Yuan nodded, “That’s why I’ve come to find the Supreme Being.”

“I see.” Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded, appearing calm on the surface, but his heart was anything but serene.

“Understanding all the Time models is still a distance away from fully comprehending the Rule of Time. I need to ascertain exactly where you are on this path.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being composed himself and then spoke.

“Okay.” Lin Yuan nodded, curious about how far he was from fully comprehending the Rule of Time.

“In that case, I’ll have Nalan spar with you solely using the understanding of Time Rules,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said.

The simplest method to discern Lin Yuan’s position was for them to spar against each other, but as a Supreme Being, Xia Qin naturally wouldn’t spar with Lin Yuan himself.

Thus, he planned to have Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, come and test Lin Yuan.

As a Grade A Tier 10, poised to comprehend all the Rule of Time models, Nalan was well-suited to gauge Lin Yuan’s capabilities.

Soon.

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, also appeared beside Lin Yuan.

“Supreme Being.” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, bowed slightly to Xia Qin Supreme Being, somewhat puzzled.

“Nalan, spar with the Galaxy Master, and remember, you can only use your understanding of Time Rules,” Xia Qin Supreme Being instructed directly.

“Spar?”

“With the Galaxy Master?”

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, was somewhat shocked.

He was a prominent Grade A Tier 10, and he was to spar with the Ninth Rank Galaxy Master?

Wasn’t that bullying? No matter how powerful the Galaxy Master was, or how against the odds his performance at the Ninth Rank, he was still just at the Ninth Rank. What difference did it make if he had opened up billions of Spatial Layers?

Moreover, the Supreme Being meant that they were to spar purely on the basis of the understanding of Time Rules, so the Galaxy Master couldn’t even use his most proficient Spatial Layers.

This was… this was just too much of a bully to the Galaxy Master.

Even Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, found it somewhat unbearable.

“What does the Supreme Being mean by this?” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, thought to himself, “Could it be that he thinks the Galaxy Master is advancing too smoothly in his cultivation and wants to give him some setbacks and hardships, so he’s having me temper the Galaxy Master?”
